concept.title: Progress from to-dos and sub-tasks
concept.shortdesc: A task's progress is worked out, so it never goes stale:

strow.stentry: Is in Done on the board
The share of its to-dos ticked off, with each sub-task counting by its own progress
0% until it is moved to Done

conbody.p: A to-do is a small job, a day or two of work at most, so it has one date only: an optional deadline. It has no start, duration or bar, and is never drawn on the chart. Add a task's to-dos in its panel, under To-dos, with a deadline if you like, and tick them off there; a deadline that has passed is shown in red. The same list is on the task's card on the Board. They are ordinary project to-dos, so the To-dos page lists them with the others, and ticking one off anywhere moves the task's bar. A task with two of its four to-dos ticked is 50%; a task with one finished sub-task and one at 50% is 75%.
